featured_reviews.review_text: This Pinklay shop would not take their own Cashback coupon which I received from Pinklay’s Hyderabad shop. They don’t have changing room and exchange is within 7 days. They don’t sell bottoms in the shop and display is limited as well. This is great example of very good product but very poor brand integrity and bad customer service ( especially in this store).

featured_reviews.name: PinnedCloud
featured_reviews.review_text:
I love this brand. I'd always bought clothes from their online store & at times, even taken the help of their email &  WhatsApp customer support. They'd always been prompt & helpful with both exchange requests & with my size and fitting queries. So I decided to visit their physical store in Bandra. The store looks tiny, but it stocks a lot. They have all the clothes in all sizes, furnishings; the cushion covers are beautiful and lots of pottery and wooden items. Unlike the employees of so many new brands, this store's Manager, Anita, knew her stuff. Lovely shopping experience.

One point to note is that they do not have a trial room, but you can slip things on, over your clothes with Anita's assistance. This is one of the many reasons why I can't help but draw a parallel between them and Fabindia of the 2000s. Wish them the same growth!

featured_reviews.name: Aayushi Sachdeva
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worse fabrics
One or two washes and it’s all faded. There’s also a texture that comes after the wash all over the fabric
I had pointed it out on one of the bed sheets that I had ordered and they had exchanged it too but it’s been happening with all the bed sheets. How many to exchange now. I would rather not buy from them anymore.
The worse part is I have gifted these bed sheets to so many people because they have amazing prints but I now I regret it so much since it looks so ugly once washed.

Edit: I have been following your wash instructions. Sadly, it's still the same.

Painful experience|Dont buy|No refunds and shipment/ return takes months|Credit note 1mnt valid only
This was one of the most stressful shopping experiences I’ve had. I ordered a dress months in advance for my daughter’s birthday, but it arrived after 45 days, long after the occasion had passed. Delivery timelines were not clearly disclosed. When the dress finally arrived, the quality was extremely poor—the fabric was hard and nothing like the images shown online.
